title: Family-Friendly Getaway | Minutes to Downtown
description:
Enjoy comfort, space, and flexibility in this well-appointed 4-bedroom, 2-bath home — perfect for families, business travelers, relocations, or extended stays.

Located in a quiet residential neighborhood while still close to shopping, dining, and major routes, this home offers the perfect balance of comfort and accessibility.

Perfect for:
✔ Families & groups
✔ Traveling professionals & corporate stays
✔ Relocations & insurance housing
✔ Teams needing a comfortable meeting space

The space
Highlights of the home:

• 4 comfortable bedrooms with plenty of sleeping space
• 2 full bathrooms for convenience
• Large dining table that comfortably seats a group — ideal for family meals, work sessions, or small board meetings
• Fully fenced backyard for privacy, kids, or pets
• Outdoor fire pit for relaxing evenings outdoors
• Garage gym to keep up your fitness routine
• Abundant storage space — great for longer stays, equipment, or luggage
• Spacious living areas designed for both relaxation and productivity

Guest access
You have access to the whole house, fenced backyard, plenty of parking on the driveway and your personal gym in the garage.
